newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Vision sees rev jump from deal.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Vision sees rev jump from deal.

text.p: Corporate Vision Inc said it expects its planned acquisition of T.L. Phipps & Co to triple its revenues.
Corporate Vision said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the privately held company for undisclosed terms. The deal is expected to close May 15.
In the most recent quarter, the company reported next income of $12.30 million, or $0.40 per share, on revenues of $33.83 million. Those fourth quarter results were released in February.
Corporate Vision President Sheryl Mabie said in a statement that T.L. Phipps brings a revenue base of about $2 million annually.
T.L. Phipps owns video teleproduction facilities. Corporate Vision is an interactive multimedia company that develops custom programs for the corporate and consumer markets.
